preprocessing: Uncentered GEO processed probe signals; log2 transform if non-log; arithmetic mean of log2 probes per gene; single-sample percentile ranks within fixed shared annotated mRNA universe; fold-local median imputation and scaling
selection: maximum mean inner-fold AUC, training only; ties lower model complexity in fixed order
external_rule: frozen trained pipeline, fixed AUC direction and threshold 0.5; evaluate once; no retuning based on external data
